entries.value: You truly are incredible. But you must stop...
I apologize on behalf of all the guardians... You shouldn't have to endure any of this...
You are strong... but not strong enough to change fate...
Please... Accept this world as it was given to you. We cannot do otherwise...
The cold is not a punishment... It's all I have left to protect you from myself.
Every blow I strike costs me more than you could imagine...
I don't want to be the one who breaks your courage...
The lake remembers every tear shed here... Don't add any more.
